commit_title: Use analytics store for consent & refactor banner
commit_message: Replace ad-hoc localStorage/event-based analytics consent handling with a centralized useAnalyticsStore. Analytics component now reads status/timestamp from the store, enforces weekly expiration via resetConsent, reacts to status changes to load/disable GA, and only shows the banner when status is null. UI markup for the consent banner was reorganized (close icon moved) for clarity. TopMenuBar now uses the analytics store (setConsent/resetConsent) instead of directly manipulating localStorage or dispatching events.
